title: VDCores Resource Policy Trace

workload.model: Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B public bring-up path before Qwen/Qwen3-8B paper target
workload.input_policy: controlled decode/resource trace with virtual-core queues, memory/compute split, and task-count metadata recorded
workload.output_policy: correctness output plus resource-policy timing trace
workload.batch_or_concurrency: single-process VDCores run aligned with PTO persistent-device queue-pressure and worker/scheduler policy captures

measurement_scope.latency_correctness_policy: final guarded RepeatM baseline policy is represented by qwen3-1p7b-repeat-guard-bench-f6b16bac and qwen3-1p7b-repeat-guard-correctness-712f88e8 without profile-slot diagnostics
measurement_scope.scheduler_queue_policy: queue pressure and allocwarp scheduler lifetime are diagnostic-scope fields from the tmp-only profile-slot patch in qwen3-1p7b-queue-scheduler-46872fa4
measurement_scope.paper_use_rule: Do not treat diagnostic scheduler fields as the final non-diagnostic latency row unless VDCores gains a stable baseline instrumentation mode with the same semantics.

model_access.why: The selected VDCores resource-policy path uses app/python/qwen3_1p7b, whose runtime context only passes Hugging Face auth when HF_TOKEN is present and supports synthetic dry-build without model access.

setup_commands: cd tmp/baselines/vdcores && DAE_COMPUTE_OPS_FILE=<artifact>/qwen3-1p7b-compute-ops.vdcore.build EXTRA_NVCC_FLAGS="-include cfloat -I<cutlass>/include -DDAE_DIAG_GUARD_REPEAT_SHUFFLE -DDAE_DIAG_WAIT_AFTER_WB_ALLOC" make clean pyext
run_commands: cd tmp/baselines/vdcores && HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=7 QWEN1P7B_NO_PREFETCH=all QWEN1P7B_LOGITS_SPLIT_M=6 DAE_BENCH_WARMUP=1 python app/python/qwen3_1p7b/sched.py --hf-cache-dir <shared-hf-cache> -b 5

cd tmp/baselines/vdcores && HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=7 QWEN1P7B_NO_PREFETCH=all QWEN1P7B_LOGITS_SPLIT_M=6 python app/python/qwen3_1p7b/sched.py --hf-cache-dir <shared-hf-cache> --correctness

import_target.notes: Importer must preserve VDCores queue depth, virtual-core assignment, memory/compute split, correctness, and timing fields for PTO persistent-device comparison.
